articles.title: Community Trust Bancorp, Inc. Reports Earnings for the 3rd Quarter 2026

articles.summary: On October 27, 2026, the Board of Directors of Community Trust Bancorp, Inc., (NASDAQ-CTBI) declared its quarterly cash dividend of $0.65 per share, which will be paid on January 4, 2027, to shareholders of record on December 15, 2026. Community Trust Bancorp, Inc., with assets of $7.1 billion, is headquartered in Pikeville, Kentucky and has 69 banking locations across eastern, northern, northeastern, central, and south central Kentucky, six banking locations in southern West Virginia, three banking locations in northeastern Tennessee, four trust offices across Kentucky, and one trust office in Tennessee. For Additional Information Please Contact Mark A. Gooch, Chairman, President and CEO, Community Trust Bancorp, Inc. at (606) 437-3229. Source: Community Trust Bancorp, Inc.
